title: All Nodes Overview
description: Core CPU, RAM, disk-space and network overview for configured Linux Node Exporter hosts. Excludes the noc-core monitoring-container target; discovers physical NICs without a device-name whitelist. Uses existing metrics only.

list.name: job
list.label: Node Exporter job
list.definition: query_result(count by(job) (node_uname_info or node_exporter_build_info or up{job="node"} or up{service=~"node[-_]exporter"}))

query.query: query_result(count by(job) (node_uname_info or node_exporter_build_info or up{job="node"} or up{service=~"node[-_]exporter"}))

list.name: instance

list.name: network_devices
list.label: Network interfaces
list.description: Interface-name pattern. Leave .* for physical interfaces. To select a bridge/bond uplink, use Custom selection under Network view and choose that uplink here.

list.name: network_exclude
list.label: Network view
list.description: Physical interfaces excludes common virtual-device names. Custom selection includes the interface pattern above except loopback; choose either physical members or their logical uplink, not both.

list.name: sample_freshness_s
list.description: Maximum accepted scrape/metric sample age, exclusive. 90 seconds assumes 30-second scrapes.

panels.title: Node metrics
panels.description: One row per configured Node Exporter host, excluding noc-core and its internal exporter target. CPU/RAM are used percentages; disk is the fullest eligible filesystem. Network sums the selected eligible interfaces. Missing values are N/A rather than zero.
